verdict.rationale: Exa generates AI output over web data rather than the user's own data. Its answer endpoint returns cited answers (exa-gh-3, exa-gh-8), and Exa Agent does grounded research synthesis (exa-docs-25, exa-docs-26). Websets, buildable in a no-code dashboard (exa-docs-7), verifies and enriches user-defined lists with AI-populated fields (exa-docs-8, exa-docs-28), which is the closest thing to in-product insights on 'my data'; hands-on users report enrichment columns coming back empty and verification stalling (exa-comm-2, exa-comm-3). Missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions over user-supplied or uploaded data, proactive suggestions inside the product, reliable enrichment shown by hands-on use.
